name: codex-ai-lab-skills
description: Reusable public-facing agent skills for technical writing, product framing, charting, and agentic development lifecycle workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Public agent skills for writing, charting, product framing, and ADLC workflows.
interface.longDescription: A public AI Lab collection of reusable agent skills for clear technical writing, editorial charting, customer-centric product discovery, evidence synthesis, and agentic development lifecycle workflows from planning through verification and trace-to-eval improvement.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this technical note so it sounds concrete and useful.
Run a design-thinking simulation for this product idea.
Create an editorial chart brief and contact-sheet-backed implementation plan.
Act as the sprint lead for this goal and coordinate scoped sub-agent work.
Turn this task into success criteria, a TDD loop, verification evidence, and a trace-to-eval follow-up.
